job.raw:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --nodelist=hpc-02,hpc-03,hpc-04,hpc-05,hpc-07
#SBATCH --job-name=hpl-mkl
#SBATCH --nodes=5
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=16
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --partition=batch
#SBATCH --time=02:00:00
#SBATCH --exclusive
#SBATCH --hint=nomultithread
#SBATCH --output=run.sh-%j.out
#SBATCH --error=run.sh-%j.err

# --- Intel oneAPI: MKL + Intel MPI ---
source /opt/intel/oneapi/setvars.sh --force

# MKL: single-threaded (pure MPI, 1 rank per core)
export MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
export MKL_DYNAMIC=FALSE
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
# Sandy Bridge tops out at AVX (no AVX2/FMA)
export MKL_ENABLE_INSTRUCTIONS=AVX

# --- Intel MPI over InfiniBand via libfabric/verbs ---
export I_MPI_FABRICS=shm:ofi
export I_MPI_OFI_PROVIDER=verbs
export FI_PROVIDER=verbs
# export FI_VERBS_IFACE=ibp176s0   # uncomment if libfabric needs explicit IB iface

# Bootstrap via SSH (not srun/PMI) — fixes "OMPI was not built with SLURM PMI"
# Slurm still allocates the nodes exclusively; Hydra just uses SSH to launch.
export I_MPI_HYDRA_BOOTSTRAP=ssh
export I_MPI_HYDRA_BOOTSTRAP_EXEC_EXTRA_ARGS="-o StrictHostKeyChecking=no"

# Pinning: 1 rank per physical core
export I_MPI_PIN=1
export I_MPI_PIN_DOMAIN=core
export I_MPI_PIN_ORDER=compact
export I_MPI_DEBUG=4

# Ulimits
ulimit -l unlimited
ulimit -n 65536

# --- HPL binary on shared NFS (Intel MPI + MKL BLAS) ---
HPL_BIN=/opt/intel/hpl/xhpl
ln -sf "$HPL_BIN" ./xhpl

ldd ./xhpl | grep -E 'not found' && {
  echo "ERROR: missing shared libraries for ./xhpl on $(hostname)"; exit 1; }

# Build hostfile from Slurm allocation (needed for SSH-bootstrap Hydra)
scontrol show hostnames "$SLURM_JOB_NODELIST" > hostfile
echo "Hostfile:"
cat hostfile

# Run HPL — 80 ranks (5 nodes x 16 cores)
mpirun -n $(( SLURM_NNODES * SLURM_NTASKS_PER_NODE )) \
       -ppn ${SLURM_NTASKS_PER_NODE} \
       -f hostfile \
       ./xhpl
